tenders.title: SELECTION OF Architects / Architectural Firms for providing architectural designs and services towards Development of Research Park and associated facilities at IIT Bhilai
tenders.tendering_authority: Indian Institute of Technology Bhilai (IIT Bhilai)
tenders.scope_summary: This tender seeks architectural firms for design services for a Research Park at IIT Bhilai, encompassing BIM modeling, sustainability assessment, quantity surveying, and cost estimation. The selected firm will be responsible for preparing all drawings in BIM/RIVET and conducting clash detection.
key_points: The work involves architectural designs and services for the development of a Research Park and associated facilities at IIT Bhilai.
Services include BIM modelling and sustainability assessment.
Quantity surveying and cost estimation are part of the scope.
Proficiency in BIM platforms (Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD or equivalent), CAD, 3D visualization, and documentation tools is required.
All drawings must be prepared in BIM/RIVET with clash detection features.
Minimum average annual turnover of Rs. 3.0 Crores in the last three financial years (2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25) is required.
Evaluation will be based on Quality-cum-Cost Based Selection (QCBS) methodology.
Tender fee is Rs 1000/- and EMD is required.

tenders.title: GeM Bid for 3D Laser Scanning and Imaging System as per MHA QRs
tenders.scope_summary: This GeM tender is for the procurement of a 3D Laser Scanning and Imaging System as per Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) Quality Requirements. MSEs and Startups are eligible for relaxation in experience criteria.
key_points: The tender is for a 3D Laser Scanning and Imaging System as per MHA Quality Requirements.
MSEs and Startups are eligible for relaxation in experience criteria and turnover criteria.
The bid is split into technical and financial components.
Documents required from seller include experience criteria, past performance, bidder turnover, certificates, and OEM authorization.
Minimum average annual turnover of the bidder for 3 years is 30 Lakhs.
Years of past experience required for same/similar service is 3 years.
The local content requirement for Class 1 and Class 2 local suppliers is 50% and 25% respectively.

tenders.title: NALCO GeM Tender 2026 for VR Training Module at Smelter Plant, Angul
tenders.tendering_authority: NALCO (National Aluminium Company Limited) via GeM
tenders.scope_summary: NALCO has released a GeM tender for the development and commissioning of a VR Training Module for Pot Room Activities at its Angul Smelter Plant. The project aims to strengthen industrial safety training through immersive AR/VR-based simulations, SOP-based learning, PTM simulator operations, hazard identification, emergency workflows and performance analytics.
key_points: Development and commissioning of a VR Training Module for Pot Room Activities at Angul Smelter Plant.
The solution must include hardware, software, and integration services for immersive training in critical plant areas.
The proposed system includes a VR Safety Training Module for SOPs, hazard identification, PPE usage, emergency response, and plant walkthroughs.
Eligible OEMs, authorized dealers, agencies, or channel partners with relevant VR training module experience and required financial credentials can participate.
Minimum average annual turnover of ₹11.36 Lakhs during the last three financial years is required.
Bidder should have executed/supplied at least 1 VR Training Module during the last 7 years.
